title: New Aircrafts & Stunning Liveries in MSFS2024 Marketplace! ✈️✨ | Weekly Update | Week 34
description:
🔍 Description
🚀Check out the latest updates in the Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace this week! While only a few new aircraft have been added, including the intriguing F406 Caravan II, there are still some exciting additions. Several cockpit and livery enhancements are now available for both default and third-party aircraft. Don’t forget to like, comment, and explore more thrilling Microsoft Flight content!🌍🛫
